narrative: Hi, my name is Daniel Okafor, policy WTP-ESS-100231. I had to cancel my trip to Lisbon (flying out 20 August). On 14 August I was taken to St. Bartholomew's Hospital with appendicitis and had emergency surgery. The surgeon told me not to fly for at least three weeks. I cancelled the flight and hotel the next day but neither would refund me. I'm claiming the flight ($842.00) and the hotel ($1,150.00), so $1,992.00 in total. Discharge letter and both cancellation confirmations attached.
